title: IndicFormBench Template Annotation Schema v0.1
description: Schema for a single annotated form template. One JSON file per template under data/templates/<template_id>.json. bbox = [x, y, w, h] in PIXELS @ 200 DPI, origin top-left, x right, y down, w width, h height. Fill engine converts px->PDF points (x72/200). v0.1: optional per-element `page` (0-based) added for multi-page templates; backward-compatible (schema_version stays '0').

schema_version.description: Version of the schema this file conforms to. Frozen; do not change once annotation begins.

template_id.description: Unique, stable identifier. Convention: <form_type>_<state>_<nnn>, e.g. rti_mp_001.

source_url.description: The public URL the blank template was downloaded from. Required for licence verification (Phase 1.3).

licence.description: Licence of the template. Only GODL-India, CC, or public-domain may be used; 'other' and 'unclear' must be reviewed before inclusion.

language.description: Script/language of the form text. 'bilingual' means both Devanagari and Latin appear on the same form. 'bengali'/'tamil' (v0.2, scope v3) are forms whose native-language labels are in that script; they may also carry English.

fillable.description: True if the PDF has AcroForm fields (checked with pypdf, Phase 1.4); false for flat/image PDFs.

checkboxes.description: Every checkbox or option/radio box. If a form has none, this is an empty array.

id.description: Unique within the template. Convention: cb_<group>_<n> or cb_<semantic>, e.g. cb_aadhaar_a, cb_gender_male.

bbox.description: Bounding box of the checkbox itself (the box outlines).

label_text.description: The text of the label associated with this box, exactly as printed.

label_script.description: Script the label text is written in. 'bilingual' = Devanagari + Latin; 'bengali'/'tamil' (v0.2) = labels containing that script, with or without English alongside.

group.description: Option-group identifier, e.g. 'applicant_type'. Boxes sharing a group form a mutually exclusive radio set; a free checkbox has a unique group. Lowercase with underscores.

mark.description: How a person marks this option, when it is not a printed square (v0.2). 'circle': the box sits on a printed option word (e.g. Yes / No, ஆம் / இல்லை) and the chosen word is circled by hand. Optional; default is a tick/cross/etc. in a printed box.

page.description: 0-based page index the element sits on within the source PDF. Optional; defaults to 0 (first page). Added v0.1 for multi-page templates.

fields.description: Every data-entry field (text input, textarea, date, etc.).

id.description: Unique within the template. Convention: f_<semantic>, e.g. f_name_english, f_dob.

label_text.description: The label/question text exactly as printed.

label_script.description: Script the label text is written in. 'bilingual' = Devanagari + Latin; 'bengali'/'tamil' (v0.2) = labels containing that script, with or without English alongside.

value_bbox.description: The region where the value/answer is written (the blank entry area).

value_type.description: Semantic type of the expected value. v0.3 adds table-cell types: age, gender, year, board, marks, max_marks, occupation, employer, designation, country, tin, yes_no.

value_script.description: Script the value is written in, when it differs from what label_script implies (v0.2), e.g. a 'Name in English (BLOCK LETTERS)' field on a Tamil form is 'latin'. Optional; by default latin labels get Latin values and every other label script gets values in its own script ('bilingual' -> Devanagari).

page.description: 0-based page index the element sits on within the source PDF. Optional; defaults to 0 (first page). Added v0.1 for multi-page templates.

tables.description: Every table on the form, with full cell structure.

id.description: Unique within the template. Convention: tbl_<semantic>, e.g. tbl_aadhaar.

bbox.description: Bounding box of the whole table.

cells.description: Every cell in the table, including both header and body cells.

row.description: Row index, 0-based. Do not advance for rowspan; a spanned cell occupies one logical (row, col) and its spans extend it.

rowspan.description: Number of rows the cell spans (1 = single row).

colspan.description: Number of columns the cell spans (1 = single column).

text.description: Cell text exactly as printed. null for an empty cell.

bbox.description: Writable area of a value cell (v0.3), pixels @ 200 DPI. Required for the fill engine to write into the cell; printed cells may omit it.

value_type.description: Marks a value cell (v0.3): text must be null in the template and the fill engine writes a value of this type. Printed (header/label) cells omit it.

value_script.description: Script of the cell's value (v0.3). Optional; by default the template language's script (english -> latin, hindi/bilingual -> devanagari, bengali, tamil).

page.description: 0-based page index the element sits on within the source PDF. Optional; defaults to 0 (first page). Added v0.1 for multi-page templates.

row_fill.description: How the fill engine leaves value cells blank (v0.3). cells: each cell independently, like fields (default). rows: each body row is filled or left blank as a whole. prefix: the first k body rows are filled and the rest left blank (a household/record table).

bbox.description: [x, y, w, h] — top-left origin, x right, y down, w width, h height. All non-negative values.
